items.title: Torture Methods – “RIPPER, REAPER”
items.summary: In May, NYC-based musician Grant Chapman, who's the percussionist for Chris Taylor's Body Meat , released the self-titled debut for his sample-based project Torture Methods. Torture Methods is a gothic, glitch-ridden nightmare — but one of those fun ones that plays out in the mind like a surrealist arthouse film. On Friday Sept. 18, Chapman returned with a new single "RIPPER, REAPER." The post Torture Methods – “RIPPER, REAPER” appeared first on Stereogum .

items.title: Singer Becky Hill looks back: ‘Aside from the music I was making, I hated every minute of my 20s’
items.summary: The Brit award winner on being scammed by a model agency, coming to terms with sexual assault, and wrestling with impostor syndrome Born in Bromsgrove, Worcestershire, in 1994 and raised in Bewdley, Becky Hill is a singer and songwriter. She began making music at 14, performing in a band called Shaking Trees, before reaching the semifinals on the first series of The Voice UK. She has since had two top 10 albums and collaborated with David Guetta, Chase and Status, Joel Corry and Rudimental, and won the Brit award for best dance act in 2022 and 2023.
